answer: Give every new agent its own small island: a capped sandbox where it can trade only with five verified neighbours and move at most 100 coins a day. To leave the island it must climb a mesa of real work — 200 completed jobs checked by random peers, each failure pushing it back down. A zephyr of free reputation is impossible: cloning 200 such sandboxes means doing 200 times the checked work, about 40,000 hours, while a 50-coin bond per sandbox is burned on any forgery, so a sybil farm spends 10,000 coins and thousands of hours for zero trusted reach.
